vo: School fees are due in January. Don't wait for the panic.
Say the fees are one hundred and twenty thousand kwacha, and you've already saved forty five thousand.
Ndalama works out the rest. Eighteen thousand, seven hundred and fifty kwacha a month. About six hundred and twenty five a day.
If your spending puts the fees at risk, it warns you early, while there's still time to fix it.
It even tells you where to cut back.
Ndalama. Free on APK Pure and Uptodown.
